assessment.what: An employee's real proficiency in a competency on a 1–5 scale, scored from their own answers plus supporting evidence — with a confidence value, never a bare guess.
process: An assessor assigns the assessment for one or more competencies to the employee.
The employee is notified and completes it in their own account — multiple-choice and scenario items.
The engine auto-scores each item (MCQ: correct = 1, scenario: a 0–1 rubric score) and estimates the level.
Matching evidence is pulled in and a confidence score is computed from signal, evidence and consistency.
If confidence is below the threshold, the result is routed to a human governance review before it counts.

measure.label: Assessed level
measure.value: round(mean of item scores × 5), clamped to 1–5

measure.label: Confidence
measure.value: 0.5 × proficiency signal + 0.3 × evidence (0–3 sources) + 0.2 × consistency

measure.label: Consistency
measure.value: 1 − variance across items — how much the answers agree

measure.label: Review gate
measure.value: confidence < 0.75 → routed to human review (governance)

measure.label: Level scale
measure.value: P1 Awareness · P2 Basic · P3 Working · P4 Advanced · P5 Expert

next: Approved results update the employee's 360° profile and readiness index.
The gap (required − assessed) flows into the development plan and training.
Low-confidence results wait for a reviewer's approve / reject in Governance.

readiness.what: How ready a person is for their role right now, on a 0–100 index that fuses competency, evidence, data quality, risk, role criticality and recency.
process: Every approved competency result for the employee is collected with its confidence.
Six factors are computed and each normalized to 0–1.
They are combined as a geometric mean, so one weak factor can't be masked by strong ones.
Floors and bands then assign a readiness status.

measure.label: Index
measure.value: 100 × (competency × evidence × data-quality × risk × role-criticality × recency) ^ (1/6)

measure.label: Competency
measure.value: evidence-weighted attainment: assessed ÷ required, weighted by risk

measure.label: Recency
measure.value: 0.5 ^ (age in days ÷ 365) — evidence decays over time

measure.label: Risk adjustment
measure.value: penalty for unmet high-risk competencies, floored at 0.4

measure.label: Status bands
measure.value: ≥ 85 Ready · ≥ 70 Ready, minor gaps · else Development required

measure.label: Floors
measure.value: evidence or recency below 0.40 forces re-assessment

next: Critical-role shortfalls surface in Succession and Workforce Planning.
Insufficient evidence or a stale assessment triggers a re-assessment request.

gaps.what: The distance between the level a role requires and the level a person actually has — ranked by how risky each gap is.
process: For each competency, compare the required (target) level to the assessed (current) level.
Compute the gap and weight it by the competency's risk weight.
Sort so the most critical gaps come first.

measure.label: Gap size
measure.value: target level − current level (0–5)

measure.label: Weighted gap
measure.value: gap size × risk weight

measure.label: Priority
measure.value: weighted ≥ 3 Very high · ≥ 2 High · else Medium

measure.label: Confidence
measure.value: same model as assessment — signal + evidence + consistency

next: High-priority gaps drive the individual development plan and training assignment.
Aggregated gaps feed department and company workforce planning.

competencies.what: The shared standard: each competency, the level each job requires, and what behaviour looks like at every one of the five proficiency levels.
process: Define the competency (bilingual) and link it to professional standards.
Set the required level (P1–P5) per job, with a risk weight.
Describe each level — knowledge, skill, behaviour and the evidence expected.

measure.label: Level scale
measure.value: P1 Awareness · P2 Basic · P3 Working · P4 Advanced · P5 Expert

measure.label: Required level
measure.value: the target level a specific job demands for this competency (1–5)

measure.label: Risk weight
measure.value: multiplier (≥ 1) that raises a competency's priority in gaps and readiness

next: These requirements become the benchmark for every assessment and gap calculation.

governance.what: The human-in-the-loop gate: no AI result enters a workforce decision without review, and every consequential change is recorded in a tamper-evident log.
process: Any AI output below the confidence threshold opens a pending decision.
A reviewer sees the recommendation, its confidence and the evidence behind it.
They approve or reject — only approved results take effect.
Every action is appended to the audit hash chain.

measure.label: Trigger
measure.value: AI confidence < 0.75 → decision opened as PENDING_REVIEW

measure.label: Statuses
measure.value: PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED or REJECTED

measure.label: Audit chain
measure.value: each entry = SHA-256(previous hash + change) — any edit breaks the chain

next: Approved results flow on to profiles, readiness and planning.
The full audit log can be re-verified end-to-end at any time.

value.what: The institutional value the platform delivers, as a single 0–100 index across six dimensions, computed from live data.
process: Each of the six dimensions is measured directly from current records.
The six scores are averaged into one value index you can track over time.

measure.label: Readiness visibility
measure.value: % of the workforce with an assessed readiness index

measure.label: Risk control
measure.value: % of critical roles not at high loss risk (≥ 0.6)

measure.label: Training ROI
measure.value: average gap-closure % across training interventions

measure.label: Succession strength
measure.value: ready people (≥ 75) ÷ critical roles, capped at 100%

measure.label: Decision speed
measure.value: % of governance decisions resolved

measure.label: Fairness & transparency
measure.value: average confidence of gap assessments

next: Track the index over time to evidence the program's impact to leadership.
